meta.description: Colorado housing events that no feed lists, checked by hand. scripts/news/fetch_housing_events.py merges them with CHFA's calendar feed and Housing Colorado's upcoming-events list into data/policy/housing-events.json. Each entry names the page it was checked against, the date, and the words on that page it rests on.
meta.review: Quarterly: re-check each organizer's events page and add the next conference dates as soon as they are announced. Past events drop off by themselves.

checked.quote: The 2026 Housing Colorado Conference will be held October 14-16 at the Keystone Conference Center in Keystone, Colorado.
